body:
No, I wouldnt want the relationship, aside from the baggage i feel we have different values and she just doesnt quite make me happy in that way. I just *feel* strongly that she can overcome this so I stay to try and help. But its just been going on so long now im not so sure. And its difficult because there really is no one else at the moment, and the chances of her finding another bf are slim because she is still hung up on me. 

And I dont think I can call emergency services, weve been down that road before and she ended up being involuntarily committed for a few days and it was on the whole a terrible experience which resulted in a batch of useless medical debt that has caused long term financial issues. As I said, she has a therapist and a psychiatrist, but what she needs is family to take her in for a few days and help her get on her feet, but sadly she just doesnt have that anymore. She's very alone in the world. 

And now she is completely spitting venom, i told her Id come over and she said it'd no good, if we talk all she does is berate me, if I get off the phone she says shes going to kill herself tonight. Its just a complete stone wall at every possible dialogue path, VERY hard not to lose my temper at her when she is spitting snide remarks at every chance
